name: Google AI Studio
summary: Web playground for prompting Gemini models, billed as the fastest path from prompt to production; chat needs sign-in.
description: Google AI Studio is described as the fastest path from prompt to production with Gemini. The /prompts/new_chat page redirects to Google sign-in, so the chat interface itself is not readable without an account; the public welcome page carries only the title and one-line description.
